zh.text: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校位于美国威斯康星州麦迪逊市，是一所公立研究型大学。该校成立于1848年，是威斯康星大学系统的旗舰分校。校园坐落于门多塔湖畔，设有13个学院和系部。其学术项目涵盖136个本科专业、148个硕士项目及120个博士项目。

en.text: The University of Wisconsin–Madison is a public research university located in Madison, Wisconsin. Founded in 1848, it serves as the flagship campus of the University of Wisconsin System. The main campus is situated on the shores of Lake Mendota. The university is organized into 13 schools and colleges. It offers 136 undergraduate majors, 148 master's degree programs, and 120 doctoral programs.
